reality_check_2026_08_27.method: Every verdict read from the named file or run read-only against production. Full detail in 01-spec.md section 2.
reality_check_2026_08_27.the_good_news: EIGHT coordination endpoints already exist and work: propose-slot, accept, counter-propose, flip-to-remote, dispatch, confirm-received, complete, cancel. The legal date window is computed server-side (getVisitDateRange: post-by minus 2 days, else posting window minus 3, else campaign end minus 3; earliest is tomorrow). Two reschedules per side are enforced and counted separately. production_event_log records EVERY action — the shoot is the only step in the whole spine that does this.
reality_check_2026_08_27.and_none_of_it_has_a_screen: Grep both navigators for a production route: ZERO hits. The shoot is a panel inside the contract page on both phones — BrandContractScreen:628 'Production coordination panel' and ContractScreen:366 'Production Arrangement'. So a notification about the shoot can only point at a contract and hope the reader scrolls. getLog exists and nothing calls it.
reality_check_2026_08_27.the_box_has_no_contents: production_events carries shipment_courier, shipment_awb and four timestamps. Searched the whole schema and backend/src for a parcel or shipment items: NOTHING. A shipment knows it was sent and when it landed and has no idea what is inside it. This is the genuinely new work.
reality_check_2026_08_27.receipt_completes_the_shoot_and_should_n: confirmReceived sets status='completed'. So today the box landing IS the shoot finishing — which would advance her to step 4 before she has photographed anything, on both phones. See decisions_taken.
reality_check_2026_08_27.never_actually_used: Production holds 4 shoots (1 shipment confirmed on Delhivery, 3 visits completed) but NO visit carries a slot and production_event_log has ZERO entries — the practice world was seeded straight into its end state rather than driven through the endpoints. Every endpoint above is live in the sense that it exists and is tested, not in the sense that anyone has driven it. Stage 4's walk is the first real exercise of any of it.

decisions_taken.split_receipt_from_completion: Confirming receipt will move the shoot to in_progress, not completed. It finishes when SHE says the shoot is done — which is what `complete` already exists for and what the visit path already does. Cost: it changes the field collabStep reads for shootDone, which is what Stage 3's step number depends on. B-9 pins the outcome — a received parcel with no shoot yet must still read step 3 on both phones.
decisions_taken.parcel_items_are_a_table_not_json: One row per item: which product, how many, and her verdict. She answers per item and the brand resends per item, so each has its own small history. A JSON blob would make 'she flagged the Indigo saree' a string-edit rather than a row. And a resend is a SECOND parcel, not an edit — overwriting the first would erase the fact that something went wrong.
decisions_taken.dropping_an_item_only_touches_a_handpick: The board says dropping an item 'removes that saree from what she can sell'. True on a hand-picked list. On store or category scope the item is still in scope, and carving a hole in a scope Part 4 defined as resolved live would be inventing a rule. Flagged because it is the one place this board reaches into another stage's machinery.

open_question_for_founder.question: The board's creator screen has 'Mark one damaged' beside the missing flag. Missing and damaged are different problems — one never arrived, one did and is unusable — and the platform has no rule about who bears a damaged item.
open_question_for_founder.recommendation: Record it and treat it exactly like missing: she shoots what she can, the brand resends or drops it. That is true, useful, and invents no liability rule. If damaged should be handled differently from missing, that is a commercial decision I should not make.
open_question_for_founder.answered: founder 2026-08-27: go with the recommendation. Damaged is recorded and treated exactly like missing — she shoots what she can, the brand resends or drops it. No liability rule invented.

founder_ruling_2026_08_27.quote: "shoot phase done when creator agreed for shoot plan when store visit planned...next after completion of shooting then creator and brand both confirmed shoot is done...next after that content submission. next if the shoot is remote then creator confirm that shoot is done....for store visit we keep both brand and creator as confirming parties, for remote only creator as confirming member because brand dont know at this stage whether shoot is done or not. anyway creator needs to submit the content in next stages for both brand so we confirm this by doing so."
founder_ruling_2026_08_27.what_it_settles: It answers 01-spec section 5.1 better than my own recommendation did, and it adds a rule I had not asked about: WHO may say the shoot is done depends on the MODE.

the_rule.store_visit: EITHER party may mark it done. The brand was there — they know it happened.
the_rule.remote_or_shipment: ONLY the creator. The brand cannot see whether she has shot anything, so letting them close it would be letting them assert something they cannot know.
the_rule.receipt_is_not_completion: Confirming a parcel arrived moves the shoot to in_progress, never completed. The box landing is not the shooting happening.
the_rule.the_real_proof: Content submission in Stage 5 is the actual evidence the shoot happened. The confirmation here is a marker, not the proof — which is why it is safe to let the creator alone give it on a remote shoot.

founder_ruling_2026_08_27.against_the_code: completeVisit already allows EITHER party and already refuses any mode that is not visit — so the store-visit half is already right. For shipment/remote there is currently NO way to mark a shoot done at all: the only completion path is confirmReceived, which is creator-only and wrongly sets completed. So the change is to let complete accept a shipment from the CREATOR ONLY, and to stop confirmReceived completing anything.
